name: lull-app-store-header
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Adapt the supplied Lull brand artwork into a polished finished campaign image. References are existing Lull character/toy identity and material references, not screenshots. Preserve their distinctive rounded forms and friendly faces. Tactile matte felt, warm pale wood, restrained soft lighting, fine fibers, generous breathing room, premium editorial composition. Warm cream #F8F3E9, dark cocoa #49352A, terracotta, butter yellow, sage and deep twilight navy. No photoreal people, no fake app UI, no phone mockups, no badges, no extra brands, no claims of awards, no purchase button, no price or invented feature. This is an illustration, not a gameplay screenshot. Avoid busy nursery clutter, shiny plastic and oversaturated colors.
Asset type: App Store product-page header artwork. Wide panoramic 21:9 composition intended for 3840 x 1646 output, opaque. Create a beautifully art-directed still life in Lull's world: the exact terracotta rounded felt mascot with butter-yellow cap is a modest central focal point, nestling a cream crescent. On either side are the real Lull wooden pastel xylophone and sleepy wooden shape-sorter, grouped close to the mascot in the middle 60% of the frame. Small felt shapes, a few pearly bubbles and a tiny red felt ladybug lend a sense of quiet playful life. Everything sits naturally on one pale warm linen surface; an extremely subtle soft navy twilight curve at the back right connects to the existing icon. Warm mostly-cream background. Not a gallery of separate cards. Eye-level miniature set photography, gently asymmetrical, enough depth to feel handmade and alive. Let the outer 15% edges and top/bottom margins breathe so this crops gracefully. Objects do not touch or clip frame edges. NO TEXT at all: Apple supplies the app title in the interface. Make the existing toys recognizable and carefully proportioned, no extra vehicles or invented toy types.

name: lull-social-play-then-rest
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Adapt the supplied Lull brand artwork into a polished finished campaign image. References are existing Lull character/toy identity and material references, not screenshots. Preserve their distinctive rounded forms and friendly faces. Tactile matte felt, warm pale wood, restrained soft lighting, fine fibers, generous breathing room, premium editorial composition. Warm cream #F8F3E9, dark cocoa #49352A, terracotta, butter yellow, sage and deep twilight navy. No photoreal people, no fake app UI, no phone mockups, no badges, no extra brands, no claims of awards, no purchase button, no price or invented feature. This is an illustration, not a gameplay screenshot. Avoid busy nursery clutter, shiny plastic and oversaturated colors.
Asset type: finished Instagram/Facebook portrait feed poster, 4:5, intended 1080 x 1350. Strong readable mobile typography and sophisticated simple layout.
Exact text, no additional copy:
small brand at top: "lull"
large elegant dark-cocoa serif headline, two lines: "Play, then rest."
supporting text below in a clean friendly sans serif: "Set a play limit. Lull rests when time is up."
small footer: "A quiet toybox for ages 2–6"
Keep all type at least 8% inside image edges, solid clean letterforms, high contrast. Top 40% warm cream with lots of space for typography. Mascot exactly matches yellow cap, dark closed eyes, small smile and coral cheeks of reference. A few softly stitched stars, not a busy sky. Cream-to-twilight backdrop. The moon is the emotional hero: gentle end to play, not a bedtime or sleep promise. No clock face, no progress UI, no sleeping child, no extra text.
